# The Hidden Cost of Scattered Handlers

#### Course: React Beyond Basics

## The Hidden Cost of Scattered Handlers

With the logic spread out, there's no single place that answers the question:

"What are all the things that can happen to entries?"

If another developer (or your future self) wants to understand every way entries can change, they have to hunt through the component.

And this is only two actions (setting entries and adding bookmarks). Imagine adding functions to delete, edit, and reorder entries!

Each one means another setEntries() call somewhere in the file, each with its own logic buried inside a handler function body.

![Scattered Handlers](data:application/octet-stream;base64,)

As the app grows, this fragmentation compounds. We need a way to centralize all state changes in one place.

That's where reducers come in.
